_schema.products: keyed by the canonical product name vendor.detect_vendors returns (lowercase)
_schema.owner: who ships the product; an advisory counts only if this owner's artifact is affected
_schema.repo: the official source repository, when there is one
_schema.not_this_product: names that sit in this product's advisory subjects while another vendor owns the affected artifact; read by decide._owns
_schema._not_here: aliases live in vendor._ALIASES and subreddit->product in vendor._SUBREDDIT_VENDOR; not duplicated
